prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If you approach an object, take it, check its color, and perform specific task; otherwise, move forward or approach the object. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectColor    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = MoveForward    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObstacleInFront    />     <Action ID = MoveForward    /> </Sequence> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Fallback>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />         <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />     </Sequence>     <Sequence>         <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />         <Action ID = ApproachObject    />     </Sequence> </Fallback>"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectColor

	END
